title: dactylorhiza incarnata var. serotina
intro: Dactylorhiza incarnata var. serotina, commonly known as the Late Summer-cooked Marsh Orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid that belongs to the Orchidaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, which may help to soothe and calm the skin and mucous membranes. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza incarnata var. serotina include its potential to help reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit vasodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
